notes: DLC values (dlc_id, lumens, watts, efficacy, dlc_category, primary_use) must be the DLC/ENERGY STAR 'Reported' data, copied exactly. null = not known yet: QA blocks any line that uses the product until it is filled in.
field_watts = the wattage the kit is actually set to on site. Proposal savings use it; the BGE workbook always uses the DLC-reported watts.
Prices are NOT kept here (this repo is public). Put them in config/kce.local.json under 'prices': {product id: installed price incl. sensor}, or per line as unit_price.
source says where each value came from.
